description: Credit files, watchlists, medical records and collections all match on combinations that are not unique.

His new mobile number belonged to someone with unpaid accounts. He gets their collections calls for two years and cannot prove he is not them, because the caller will not say who they are looking for.
energy_note: Harassed on behalf of a stranger, indefinitely.

aspect: SCENARIO - the allergy that was not his
description: A hospital merges his file with a same-name, same-birth-year patient. The chart lists an allergy he does not have and omits a medication he does take. He finds out because a nurse reads it back.
energy_note: A clinical near-miss produced by a coincidence.

description: Automated matching happens instantly. Separating two people takes human review at an organisation that has no process for it.
